csv_scope_of_work: The objective of this contract is to provide professional engineering and planning services and technical personnel on a task work order basis, to supplement the DEPARTMENT'S District Six's Planning Office staff in the development, implementation and evaluation of transportation projects. The main activities to be performed by the CONSULTANT will include: 1. Florida s Strategic Intermodal Systems (SIS) Support 2. Interchange Access Reviews 3. Corridor and subarea studies and planning 4. Growth Management and Land Development Reviews 5. Arterial Analysis 6. Level of Service calculation and reporting 7. Project management services 8. Data collection and analysis. Additional activities that may be required by the CONSULTANT to support District Six Planning Staff can potentially include: 9. Multimodal Planning, including transit, freight, bicycle, pedestrian and other special studies 10. Design Reviews 11. Concept Development and Project Development Support 12. Public Involvement Support 13. Landscape Architect 14. Lane Repurposing Studies
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Districtwide Systems Planning Support
short_description: Districtwide transportation planning support services for FDOT District 6 on a task-order basis.
project_scope: On-call districtwide transportation planning support for FDOT District 6 Planning Office, including Strategic Intermodal Systems support, interchange access reviews, corridor and subarea studies, growth management and land development reviews, arterial analysis, level of service calculations and reporting, data collection and analysis, multimodal planning, design reviews, concept development, project development support, public involvement support, landscape architecture, and lane repurposing studies. No specific structure, span, or building area is defined.
services: Professional engineering and planning services on a task work order basis; civil engineering, transportation planning, traffic studies, land use planning, public transit planning, urban studies/planning/design, and project management support.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style districtwide planning support without a defined structural project.
- Focus is transportation planning, studies, reviews, and project management rather than structural design.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure scope is specified.
- Falls under pure planning/consulting activities, which are generally not relevant for sbp.
- Although design reviews and concept support are mentioned, there is no concrete engineering design package for a specific structure.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents; the source states contract value / total construction cost as 1.5M. As this appears to describe contract value rather than actual construction cost, it is recorded as stated.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee for sbp-type services is stated. The source only gives an overall contract value of 1.5M USD for the on-call services contract.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include civil engineering, construction/project management, land use planning, planning/master planning, public transit planning, traffic studies, transportation planning, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
